services.desc: Grant will bolster nonprofit organization’s public wildlife education and outreach efforts. services.name: Teen Programs
services.desc: Hello, scoutmasters and troop leaders! Lindsay Wildlife Experience offers four scout programs tailored to meet your troop’s needs, aligning with your badge and rank requirements. Our teen Outstanding Wildlife Leaders (OWLs) will lead your group through wildlife-themed programs that include activities, small projects, and live animal encounters. Year-round programs. We are currently booking through the end of August: Wednesday through Friday at 3:45 pm and on Saturday and Sunday at 10:15 am and 3:45 pm. services.name: Preschool Programs
services.desc: Explore, discover, and have fun at Lindsay. These preschool programs are discovery-based and include hands-on activities and introductions to live animals. Ages: 3-5 Why does an owl hoot, when does a snake hiss, and what does the coyote say? Join us for an all-around good time as we learn the kinds of sounds that animals make and why they make them. Our preschool workshops are designed for budding nature lovers 3 to 5 years old, plus (more…) Ages: 3-5 Our California animal ambassadors have relatives all over the world! services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Ready for an adventure? Lindsay Wildlife Experience Summer Camps are packed with animal encounters, outdoor play, and exciting science activities. Perfect for kids who love to explore, play outside, and meet furry, feathered, and scaly friends! Designed for young nature lovers, our camps blend learning with fun in a unique, nature-filled setting. Choose from flexible full-day or half-day options to fit your schedule. Mission Statement Connecting people with wildlife to inspire responsibility and respect for the world we share.
